cross_provider_findings.evidence: Shopify uses GIDs; ikas exposes product/variant IDs; T-Soft exposes numeric IDs plus mutable web-service codes. Internal IDs must remain separate from provider IDs/codes.
cross_provider_findings.core_implication: Current internal ProductId/VariantId + providerProductId/providerVariantId design remains valid; T-Soft mutable codes belong in connector lookup/evidence unless a reusable alternate-ref need is proven.

cross_provider_findings.evidence: Owned Shopify showed quantity 0/untracked with availableForSale=true. T-Soft policy explicitly allows zero/negative-stock selling and payment-timing-dependent stock changes. ikas public docs expose location stockCount but not enough sellability/policy semantics.
cross_provider_findings.core_implication: Current InventoryObservation separation of quantity, tracking, providerAvailability, inventoryPolicy, freshness and derivedAvailability is justified; ikas must remain UNKNOWN where semantics are absent.

cross_provider_findings.evidence: T-Soft documents amount + Currency but uses TL/USD/EUR, requiring TL->TRY normalization. ikas bounded order capture exposes totalFinalPrice without admitted currency.
cross_provider_findings.core_implication: Current Money shape is valid; adapters must not construct Money without currency evidence and must use explicit provider currency normalization tables.

cross_provider_findings.evidence: ikas listCustomer exposes email/phone/fullName; T-Soft order API exposes customer name/email; owned Shopify evidence was intentionally PII-free.
cross_provider_findings.core_implication: CV0-CV3/customer-order authorization must remain independent of connector read permissions.

cross_provider_findings.evidence: ikas requires webhook validation but bounded evidence does not admit exact signature algorithm; T-Soft documents Secret Key + X-Hub-Signature but not exact algorithm/canonicalization.
cross_provider_findings.core_implication: Current WebhookIngressContext authenticity gate is correct; each provider needs an evidence-backed verifier and unknown algorithms fail closed.

cross_provider_findings.evidence: ikas documents status; T-Soft documents OrderStatusId. Cross-provider generic meaning is not identical.
cross_provider_findings.core_implication: Current ProviderStatus preservation is safer than premature universal order-status normalization.

cross_provider_findings.evidence: Current Product/Variant/Inventory contracts require sourceTimestamp, but the bounded ikas/T-Soft public evidence does not consistently establish a provider-origin last-updated timestamp for every entity/stock observation.
cross_provider_findings.core_implication: Do not change core yet. E3/expanded exact-schema evidence must decide whether sourceTimestamp means provider-origin timestamp only, whether observedAt can serve as source capture timestamp, or whether sourceTimestamp must become optional/typed by provenance.

required_adapter_rules: Provider IDs/codes are scoped to integration and never used as internal authorization IDs.
Currency normalization tables are explicit and versioned; unknown currency blocks Money construction.
Inventory availability is derived only from sufficient policy/tracking/sellability/freshness evidence.
Customer PII requires tenant/CV authorization regardless of connector read access.
Webhook authenticity uses provider-specific evidence-backed verification before tenant normalization/enqueue.
Provider statuses remain raw/provider-scoped until an evidence-backed semantic mapping exists.
next_evidence: Use exact public ikas/T-Soft schema plus future Ticimax/IdeaSoft E3 payloads to resolve source-timestamp semantics and adapter mapping gaps before core freeze.
